## Outgoing

- depends on `bc-codebase-design`'s contract — required, when organic exploration.

- depends on `bc-domain-modeling`'s contract — required, when glossary discovery in legacy projects.

- loads `bc-file-findings` — required, when after the owner picks findings in a project with a Where things go table.
  Filing rules (wait for the owner's pick, chosen/rejected/rest homes, main-checkout numbering, order placement and index check, plan each filed item) have one home in bc-file-findings; the caller supplies Kind, Source and item contents and keeps a one-line fallback for when the skill is not installed, which a change to the module's rules must update.

- hands off to `bc-plan-to-pipeline` — required, when after filing chosen findings in a project with a Where things go table.
  Via bc-file-findings, or directly in its fallback: once its filing is committed it runs bc-plan-to-pipeline from a settled source on each chosen item, passing the grilling's settled answers; a sequential handoff, not a nested call. bc-council-improve-architecture inherits this through its filing step.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#4-record-every-finding-projects-with-the-table)

- depends on `bc-setup-project`'s contract — required, when project has a Where things go table.
  Resolves research, ideas, work-planned and work-dropped in the scaffolded table; the generated runway convention finds a review by its architecture review commit subject. Numbers items under its worktree numbering rule.
